tei:div.tei:p: From, “Republican National Convention” in The Reform Advocate (22 June 1912), reporting on the invocation offered on the second day of the convention at the Chicago Coliseum in Chicago, Illinois on 19 June 1912.
Dr. Joseph Stolz served as Chaplain of the Republican National Convention on the second day and delivered the following Invocation:

The great throng of 14,000 persons in the Coliseum stood with bared heads to-day while Rabbi Joseph Stolz, D.D., Isaiah Temple, delivered the following prayer at the opening of the republican national convention’s second day:
